name: curate-skills
description: CURATE as Claude Code skills: sketch, catalog-resolve, generate, and emit FaaSr workflows with human-in-the-loop gates.

catalog_dir.title: Catalog directory
catalog_dir.description: Where reusable CURATE functions are stored. Empty means ~/.curate/catalog. CURATE_CATALOG_DIR overrides this.

mga_retries.title: MGA retries
mga_retries.description: Extra curate-mga attempts per function after a failed stub test. 0 matches the original CURATE. CURATE_MGA_RETRIES overrides this.

stubtest_mode.title: Stub-test mode
stubtest_mode.description: strict (default): every rank, deps installed, ModuleNotFoundError fails. parity: original CURATE behaviour (rank 1 only, no dep install, ModuleNotFoundError with declared deps passes). CURATE_STUBTEST_MODE overrides this.
